name: NanEyeC

sources.title: NanEyeC Datasheet, DS000503 v5-00, 2024-Oct-14 (ams-OSRAM AG)
sources.covers: resolution, pixel size, optical format, shutter, lens stack (EFL, DOF), ADC, frame rates, interfaces and their data rates, module footprint, power, ordering options (FOV, F#)

note: A 1 mm-footprint camera module (1040 x 1040 um +/- 60 um including sensor, lens stack and side-wall painting); its height is only in the package drawing, so size_mm is null and mass is not stated. 320 x 320, 2.4 um pixels, 1/15", rolling shutter, colour (RGB Bayer, NEC_HLBX-00) or B&W (NEC_HLCX-00), 10-bit column ADC. Frame rate 0-58 fps over the single-ended SEIM interface (75 Mbps at 58 Hz) or 4-38 fps (5-49 fps in HS mode) over LVDS (63 Mbps at 49 Hz); the stream lists the two stated maxima. Lens stack: triple element, EFL 367 um, depth of field 4 mm to infinity; the ordering table gives "FOV120; F4" without saying whether 120 degrees is horizontal or diagonal, so no FOV is entered and the library shows its labelled default until the user chooses (for reference, not entered: a pinhole of the stated EFL over the 768 um optical area would show about 93 degrees horizontally and 112 diagonally). f_number 4.0 from the ordering table. The lens model is pinhole, a labelled assumption. power_w 0.012 is the stated total for LVDS (9.7 mW with SEIM, 3.2 mW idle).
interface: SEIM single-ended serial (75 Mbps) or LVDS (63 Mbps), 4 pads
